# Start and reset the PGP stream offset at each buffer boundary

Entry 914 initializes mStreamOffset to zero. Current SetMimeCallback clears the buffer and resets the offset; Write replaces the buffer and resets it again. Read uses the offset while consuming a buffered result. Keep constructor and buffer-replacement resets aligned. A separate static concern remains: the inspected zero-ready branch does not visibly assign readCount before advancing by its value. Caller and binding behavior were not established, so no runtime defect is claimed here.

Scope: mailnews/mime/cthandlers.
